Had the best day here. Picked up from our hotel lobby right on time.
Introduction lead by Reindeer was great fun and informative.
The elephants are so beautiful, gracious and very well looked after.
There was a buffet served with choice for everyone.
The only negative was that there wasn't enough space for every group to have a go making Pad Thai, but for those that were able to, it was a great experience.
Dropped off back at hotel after.

One of the most beautiful and meaningful experiences I’ve ever had.

This place truly cares about the elephants. There is no riding, no chains, and no harm—you can clearly see that the elephants are treated with love and respect.

We had the chance to feed them, interact with them, and even help bathe them, which made the experience feel real and special, not touristy at all.

The staff are very professional and kind, and they explain everything in a way that makes you appreciate how important ethical treatment is.

If you are in Phuket, this is a must-do experience. Not only is it fun, but it also feels right.

Highly recommended! 🐘💚

The elephant jungle sanctuary allows you to get close to rescued elephants doing the things they love i.e. feeding them nutritious treats, caking them in mud, giving them a bath and interacting in a way that respects them. As rescued elephants some had been abused which was sad to learn about and they talked to us about the lasting damage done. I was impressed that even elephants not on show due to age etc are cared for. The elephants are on rotation so most of their time are on expansive grounds where they can roam. We finished the day with a cooking clas and great Thai food. Highly recommended.

An Absolute Must-Do — Top 10 Life Experience for Our Family

I don't say this lightly: visiting Elephant Jungle Sanctuary in Phuket was one of the top 10 experiences of my entire life, and my family felt the same way. If you're on the fence about booking this, stop hesitating and just do it.

From the moment we arrived, the entire experience was thoughtfully organized and deeply meaningful. We got to feed and touch the elephants up close — something that instantly melted every heart in our group. Then came the mud bath, which was as hilarious as it was unforgettable, followed by splashing around with the elephants in a pool. Pure joy doesn't even begin to cover it.

What really set this apart was how much we *learned*. The team took time to introduce each elephant individually — their personalities, their backstories, their quirks. You leave not just with incredible memories and photos, but with a genuine connection to these magnificent animals and a real appreciation for the sanctuary's mission.

We also got to make traditional Thai food, which was a wonderful bonus and gave us even more cultural depth to an already packed and incredible day.

Now — I have to talk about our guide Minty. She was, without question, the MVP of the entire experience. Smart, funny, warm, and incredibly engaging, she had our whole group laughing and participating from start to finish. She made sure no one was left out and brought so much energy and genuine passion to everything she did. Minty is the kind of guide who elevates a great experience into an unforgettable one. Hannah was also lovely and kind throughout the day as well.

If you're visiting Phuket with family, this is a non-negotiable. Book it. You won't regret a single minute.

We signed up for the half day tour and had a great experience with the elephants. Thanks to our guide Reindeer, Nancy and photographer No1 for their detailed explanation.
The elephants are so gentle, and we had experience feeding, mud wash and bathing the elephants.
After the wet activities with the elephants, clean toilets are available for a quick shower before lunch.
Its good to see that elephants roam around freely in the sanctuary area.

Absolutely incredible experience from start to finish. The sanctuary is doing such important work rescuing and caring for elephants, and you can genuinely feel the love and dedication from everyone there. I learnt so much about elephants, their behaviour, their history, and the heartbreaking situations many of them were saved from.

A massive thank you to our guide K, who was outstanding all day. So knowledgeable, passionate, and engaging you could tell how much they truly care about the elephants and their wellbeing. Hearing the rescue stories and learning about each elephant’s journey made the whole experience even more meaningful.

Such a wholesome, eye-opening and unforgettable day. If you’re visiting Phuket, this is an absolute must-do experience. Thank you to everyone at Elephant Jungle Sanctuary for the amazing work you do! 🐘❤️

We found this place by accident while driving round in our rental car. WOW! We really loved getting up close with the elephants and learning about them.

I almost walked off when I found out it was 2000baht/person for the elephant bath and feeding but after going for it I’m so glad I did.

It was absolutely amazing. The elephant bath was great fun and it was amazing to be up close and personal with the elephants. The staff at the place are such helpful, friendly and nice people. We wondered off with the wrong group and instead of losing out - the guy noticed we were missing from the right group and came and got us. Thankyou!

We got to make a food ball using a giant mortar and pestle with rice, banana and salt and feed this and bamboo to the elephants. All the staff were taking our phones of us to take pictures of us with the elephants.

It was a really great experience and I’m so glad being tight didn’t make us miss out on it. We would love to come back here on our next holiday to Phuket 😍🐘
It was such a beautiful and unforgettable experience. Everything was perfectly organized, starting with a short introduction, followed by plenty of time to feed, touch, and bathe the elephants. …

This Sanctuary is a good place to learn about elephants' natural habits, the strong relationship between the Thai people and their domestic elephants, and common misconceptions about elephants. They take over the working elephant for this place with positive reinforcement, so this Sanctuary is chain-free and has no riding elephants.

All staff are very nice and knowledgeable. You can feed the elephant by yourself with the appropriate amount of feed for them, to make their digestive system healthy, and not overfeeding. Highly recommend, such a very incredible experience.

A must do, so worth every penny for the half day experience! Excellent guides who make rules clear and talk you through each elephant so you can understand them better. Close up personal encounters that the elephants aren't forced to do, so make sure you keep alert as they are always on the move as they have free space to walk about. Great transfer service, beautiful food and even includes a photographer for the session who was amazing! I would definitely do it again!

Amazing experience! You spend a couple of hours with the elephants, living their routine and enjoying their company. The staff are kind, knowledgeable and friendly. The elephants are so well taken care of. I can’t recommend this highly enough! Plus, the food was delicious and we even got a cooking class making pad Thai!

K was INCREDIBLE! The elephants were absolutely majestic.  The entire experience was magical and unforgettable.  This sanctuary is exactly what you’re looking for, to be up close and connect with these beautiful mammals.  We fed them, we bathed them, we rinsed them off, we made their food and then learned how to make pad Thai! The lunch they serve is delicious.  K was our guide and really made the experience complete with his humor and passion for the elephants.  Thank you K
Love, your NY spice girls <3

Highly recommended to go to this place. The guide and the team are very helpful and help us to be educated about how the elephant and their behavior. Anna, Michael, Smiley and Carmin are the guide and the team on our feeding experience. The elephant are well taking care of. The guide is very knowledgeable. The team helped us to capture picture with the elephant while we fed them. I would love to come back for more option of the experience.

It is a great experience getting close to the gentle giants. It is very touristic but though the tours the sanctuary can be financed.  They offer only two Tours a day and the guid give great insights into the history of the elephants (quiet sad stories)

A must do experience!!!

What can I say, such a well designed informative tour and experience with these majestic animals.

The organisation has a few other sanctuaries across Thailand. The elephants are rescued from the timber logging industry, entertainment (rides and circus tricks) are brought here to live from the mainland. Phuket has no wild elephants.

We did the half day experience witj elephant feeding (watermelon amd sugarcane) making elephant rice balls (and feeding them), mud spa session amd elephant bathing ( you scrub them), shower off time and a lovely lunch.

Bonus extra are the free high res photographs taken by their professional photographer you can download from a QR code link after the session.

We traveled all the way from the Philippines and honestly, 1000% worth it. 🐘💚

Our tour guide Michael was AMAZING. You can instantly tell how passionate he is about elephants. Not the “memorized script” kind of passionate, but the “this man could talk about elephants for 10 business days straight” kind. 😂 He made the whole tour fun, informative, and super engaging. We learned so much from him and he explained everything so well during the orientation, from the dos and don’ts to why the sanctuary cares for the elephants the way they do.

What we loved most is how much they genuinely care about the elephants. They’re free to roam around, well taken care of, and the whole experience felt very respectful and educational. You can really see that the elephants’ welfare comes first here, which made the experience even more special.

The mahouts were also very friendly! They guided us while feeding the elephants and made us feel comfortable and not scared at all. You can tell they really care both about the elephants and the visitors, especially for first-timers like us. 🐘✨

Also, shoutout to the reception team for being so warm and friendly! They asked where we were from and then started playing Filipino songs at the reception. Instant happiness for us Filipinos abroad. 😂 Special thanks to Ana, Max, Mr. Shao, and Smiley for making our visit even more memorable!

If you’re thinking of visiting, do it. Come for the elephants, stay for Michael’s elite elephant TED Talk. 🐘✨

Minty was a fantastic host. Very informative with how to handle the gentle giants. Also threw in some humor to help relieve nervousness for us first-timers. This was an amazing experience. Great for children. Would definitely recommend EJS to everyone who wants an ethical elephant adventure. I found showering with them to be an intimate experience as each elephant would flap their ears when I scrubbed them, I even caught a smile from one :) I am blessed to have the opportunity to care for them.

Our visit to the Elephant Jungle Sanctuary in Phuket was truly an unforgettable experience. What stood out most was how ethical and caring this sanctuary is towards the elephants. The staff were incredibly knowledgeable and shared a wealth …

I booked the half-day tour. It was my first time experiencing elephants up close. The elephants are very well cared for here and seemed peaceful. At the beginning, the tour itinerary was explained. Sky, who explained everything at the start, was a really friendly and humorous person. Afterwards, we were allowed to feed the elephants watermelons, then prepare food and take mud baths with the elephants, followed by bathing with them in clean water. The elephants were very peaceful and let us stroke them without any problems. I had the impression that they really enjoyed it and the staff treated the animals with great sensitivity. Afterwards, there was a cooking class on how to prepare Pad Thai.

I really recommend it and  it was a wonderful morning.

Amazing experience at the elephant sanctuary! The tour guide Eddie was extremely knowledgeable and shared so much interesting information about the elephants and their care. Free snacks, fresh fruits, and drinks were provided, which was a lovely bonus. The elephants were very beautiful, calm, and clearly well cared for. The whole place felt peaceful and respectful toward the animals. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a meaningful and relaxing experience.

This was by far the best thing I did here. I like elephants so much. The entire staff was amazing and helped to capture the best photos. We did the half day tour where we fed, bathed, and swam with the elephants. The package also came with all your pics to download.

The staff here are incredibly kind and attentive, making it a truly unforgettable experience in Thailand. Interacting with rescued elephants in their natural habitat is both heartwarming and educational. Highly recommended for anyone wanting an ethical and memorable wildlife encounter on Phuket.

Had the best, peaceful time here with the elephants and the courteous staff.

Its like a break from the party atmosphere and all the noise.

We fed elephants, prepared their food, did mud bath and then learnt how to make pad Thai noodles and had lunch.

They also clicked our pictures and uploaded online. No extra charges for this.
Staff is very very good. Highly recommend going here.

Had a lovely time at this place. You can tell that they truly care for the elephants. I had an unfortunate experience of visiting another elephant place, which was not ethical at all. The whole experience lasted 2 minutes before I decided it was time to go. This sanctuary was completely opposite. They explained everything. We had the opportunity to feed them pineapple, stroke them, take photos and watch the bathe. It was lovely and heartwarming

Here is a natural, positive English review:

“I had a wonderful experience at the Elephant Sanctuary. The atmosphere was …

Staff were very well informed about the elephants and gave a large background before we were even able to see the elephants, which was appreciated as you really understood where the elephants were coming from.

Only thing I would say that personally should’ve been prewarned, we were told that we could touch the elephants if they are feeding I.e. feed them a bit of watermelon and you can touch the trunk. However, it was not noted that some elephants were aggressive and not to be touched, I seen many people going to feed a certain elephant then going to touch it’s face or trunk and being scolded by one of the people working with the elephants.

Appreciate the worker telling people not to touch as they could be injured if the elephant is aggressive, however to stop him from repeating himself this really should’ve been revealed in the briefing.

What a fantastic and rewarding experience! The Elephant Jungle Sanctuary provides a healthy environment for rescued elephants, in essence a retirement home for them.
Our guide for the morning was Nancy, she was very knowledgeable, and obviously cares deeply for these gentle giants. We got to observe, feed, wash, make up meals and just be with the elephants. They are clearly well cared for by their assigned caretakers. There are excellent gift shops, and I would urge you to spend generously as you are supporting what is a hugely worthwhile sanctuary.
Thank you Nancy for your guidance and information, we look forward to returning in the very near future.

This location holds significant personal value for me. The staff members are truly fortunate to be entrusted with the care of these elephants. I wholeheartedly recommend a visit to this establishment if you are traveling to Phuket, Thailand. The admission fee functions as a donation, enabling them to persist in their elephant rescue efforts and the provision of a sanctuary.

Lovely place! Great experience and wonderful guides!
They are very caring for their elephants. You can feel that you are there as a guest in their house and you have to respect the rules. …
What a wonderful experience. Staff so knowledgeable - thanks Minty, who had a story for every elephant. So amazing to see all these girls rescued and well cared for🐘💞 …
